system.description:
You lash out with your chained weapon, aiming to debilitate and restrain a foe within reach before presenting them to your allies to be maimed.

Select a creature within range, make a contested grapple check where you can use your Taijutsu attack bonus in place of athletics, or whichever is higher. If a creature becomes Grappled by this jutsu, they take your [Weapons damage] + 2d6 you immediately move them anywhere within your weapon range. For each Ally that they pass by, that ally may take a reaction to take an attack of opportunity or cast a Bukijutsu of C-Rank or lower targeting the Grappled creature.

Chain 2: Allied creatures that score a hit are inspired by your technique gaining a +2 bonus to their AC until the beginning of your next turn.

Chain 3: Allied creatures can spend their reaction to cast any jutsu of C-Rank or lower, targeting the Grappled creature.
